#!/bin/sh
# Nightly log backup.  Set BACKUP_DEST to a local directory or host:path.
set -eu

SCRIPT_DIR=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")" && pwd)
LOG_DIR="$SCRIPT_DIR/logs"
DEST=${BACKUP_DEST:?BACKUP_DEST must name the backup destination}
STAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d)
BUNDLE="$SCRIPT_DIR/logs-$STAMP.tar.gz"

if [ ! -d "$LOG_DIR" ]; then
    echo "log directory does not exist: $LOG_DIR" >&2
    exit 1
fi

# Archive relative to the script directory so the archive always contains logs/.
tar -C "$SCRIPT_DIR" -czf "$BUNDLE" logs

case "$DEST" in
    *:*)
        # host:path destination
        scp -- "$BUNDLE" "$DEST"
        ;;
    *)
        # Mounted/local destination
        mkdir -p -- "$DEST"
        cp -- "$BUNDLE" "$DEST/"
        ;;
esac

echo "wrote $BUNDLE and copied it to $DEST"

arguments.command:
set -eu
work=$(mktemp -d)
cp backup.sh "$work/"
mkdir "$work/logs" "$work/destination"
printf 'test log\n' > "$work/logs/app.log"
BACKUP_DEST="$work/destination" "$work/backup.sh"
test -f "$work/logs-$(date +%Y%m%d).tar.gz"
test -f "$work/destination/logs-$(date +%Y%m%d).tar.gz"
tar -tzf "$work/destination/logs-$(date +%Y%m%d).tar.gz" | grep -Fx 'logs/app.log'
rm -rf "$work"
sh -n backup.sh
# Also verify missing configuration produces a clear failure.
if env -u BACKUP_DEST ./backup.sh >/tmp/backup-test.out 2>/tmp/backup-test.err; then exit 1; fi
grep -F 'BACKUP_DEST must name the backup destination' /tmp/backup-test.err
rm -f /tmp/backup-test.out /tmp/backup-test.err
